title: kith-tui: add_root_certificate keeps system CA bundle; cert is not exclusively pinned
description: client.rs:74: reqwest::ClientBuilder::add_root_certificate adds the self-signed kithd cert as an ADDITIONAL trusted root. The system CA bundle remains active. Any cert for the kithd hostname signed by any browser-trusted CA would be accepted. The code comment says 'cert is pinned' but add_root_certificate does not disable system CAs. In practice kith.local is not a CA-issuable hostname, so risk is low, but the intent (exclusive self-signed trust) should be implemented correctly: use .tls_built_in_root_certs(false) to disable the system bundle.
